data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 42.799m. During 2018 gross claims outstanding increased materially to GBP 259.790m, largely driven by the reinsurance of new liabilities (199.935m) acquired during the year and a gross change in technical provision estimates of GBP 25.157m (a gross strengthening). The report also discloses a reserve in respect of prior years of GBP 59.855m included in the balance sheet. The movement used here is the gross 'change in estimates of technical provision' line from the claims outstanding movement note; note that the acquisition of new portfolios and reinsurance restructurings in 2018 materially distort year-on-year comparatives.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement taken from the claims outstanding movement table line 'Change in estimates of technical provision provisions, including foreign exchange' (gross = GBP 25,157k). The 2018 year includes acquisition of two new portfolios (reinsurance of new liabilities GBP 199,935k) and new reinsurance arrangements which materially distort comparisons; the movement line may include both prior-year re-estimates and items related to portfolio acquisitions. Claims development triangle is sparse (only 2009 and 2018 columns) and therefore not sufficient alone to compute PYD. Where amounts could not be unambiguously identified as "prior year development" by underwriting-year, values are left null or omitted.
